subject.title: feat(apps,ui): question surface parity and composer takeover

question: Should the accepted cross-platform contract keep Skip limited to Control UI/native apps, or should OpenClaw also implement a channel cancellation action before documenting universal Skip availability?
rationale: The current implementation and documented claim disagree on the supported conversation surfaces; choosing whether channels must gain the capability is a product and transport-contract decision.

options.title: Scope Skip to supported clients
options.body: Update the docs to state that Skip is available in the Control UI and native apps, while channels retain their existing answer-only interaction.

options.title: Add channel cancellation
options.body: Define and implement a portable channel cancellation action, then retain the universal documentation claim with channel proof.

recommendation.title: Scope Skip to supported clients
recommendation.body: Update the docs to state that Skip is available in the Control UI and native apps, while channels retain their existing answer-only interaction.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns the branch's cross-platform question surface work and is the clearest available routing candidate for the documented scope decision.
